head: codex/237-continuity-binding-reconciliation
title: fix(runtime): bind capability authority to Birthday continuity
body:
## Summary

- bind capability authority to the canonical provisioned policy and exact verified Birthday continuity record
- make a successfully constructed LiveAssembly the sole safe-code provisioning owner
- reject caller-recomputed token substitution while allowing explicit Runtime reauthorization

## Validation

- public API target: 1/1
- Runtime library suite: 80/80
- documentation compile-fail suite: 10/10
- strict library Clippy: passed
- independent exact-head review: no findings

Closes #237
